# MTS

MTS is a single-node embedded time series storage engine for Go applications.

## Public Interfaces

- Go package: `github.com/openmts/mts`
- Maintenance CLI: `cmd/mts-storage`

## Current Scope

- Single process, local data directory only.
- Local metadata store only.
- Query construction through Builder/API.
- No distributed query or distributed storage.
- No SQL, InfluxQL, PromQL, or MetricsQL parser.
- Internal HTTP query and operations packages are not public stable APIs.

## Key Files

- `README.md`: user-facing quick start and API boundary.
- `doc.go`: package-level godoc.
- `values.go`: write DTOs and field values.
- `query_types.go`: query DTOs and aggregate constants.
- `options.go`: engine options, defaults, and validation.
- `engine.go`: Engine public methods.
- `downsample.go`: downsample public methods.
- `cmd/mts-storage`: local storage check, repair, migrate, snapshot, restore.

## Verification

Use these commands before claiming commercial readiness:

```bash
timeout 300s goimports-reviser -project-name github.com/openmts/mts -recursive -format -rm-unused .
timeout 600s go test ./... -count=1 -timeout 10m
timeout 720s golangci-lint run ./...
timeout 600s go test $(go list ./... | grep -v '/tests/') -cover -count=1 -timeout 10m
timeout 600s go test ./tests/... -count=1 -timeout 10m
timeout 60s git diff --check
```

After the first release tag exists, check public Go API compatibility before publishing:

```bash
go run golang.org/x/exp/cmd/apidiff@latest github.com/openmts/mts@<previous-tag> .
```
